roads.name: Old Loup Road
words: Properly twisty: 56 curves in 8.1 miles, about 7 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 6,491 to 7,030 ft, with 1,201 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.46 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Loop Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 25 in 2.7 miles, about 9 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 5,744 to 5,913 ft, with 349 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 15 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.11 g.
